intro_native: This is a white IKEA TILLREDA microwave with just two knobs and one round button, so it's very simple. Let's learn how to reheat food with it!
intro_en: This is a white IKEA TILLREDA microwave with just two knobs and one round button, so it's very simple. Let's learn how to reheat food with it!

buttons.function_native: Sets the power level: Min lowest, Med medium, Max highest; the dot after Min is the defrost setting.
buttons.function_en: Sets the power level: Min lowest, Med medium, Max highest; the dot after Min is the defrost setting.

buttons.function_native: Sets cooking time (0 to 30 minutes); turning it away from 0 starts the oven.
buttons.function_en: Sets cooking time (0 to 30 minutes); turning it away from 0 starts the oven.

steps.narration_native: First, find the white round button at the bottom right. Press it gently and the door will open.
steps.narration_en: First, find the white round button at the bottom right. Press it gently and the door will open.

steps.narration_native: Look inside and make sure the glass tray sits flat on the roller ring. Both parts must be in place.
steps.narration_en: Look inside and make sure the glass tray sits flat on the roller ring. Both parts must be in place.

steps.action_native: Put the food in and close the door
steps.action_en: Put the food in and close the door
steps.narration_native: Put the food in a microwave-safe dish in the middle of the tray. Then close the door firmly; it won't heat if the door isn't fully shut.
steps.narration_en: Put the food in a microwave-safe dish in the middle of the tray. Then close the door firmly; it won't heat if the door isn't fully shut.

steps.action_native: Turn the top dial to Max
steps.action_en: Turn the top dial to Max
steps.narration_native: The top knob on the right is the power dial. For normal reheating, turn it to the right, to the mark labelled Max.
steps.narration_en: The top knob on the right is the power dial. For normal reheating, turn it to the right, to the mark labelled Max.

steps.action_native: Turn the timer dial to set the time
steps.action_en: Turn the timer dial to set the time
steps.narration_native: The middle knob with the little clock icon is the timer. Turn it clockwise to the minutes you want, for example 2. As soon as you turn it, the oven starts by itself, the tray spins and the light comes on.
steps.narration_en: The middle knob with the little clock icon is the timer. Turn it clockwise to the minutes you want, for example 2. As soon as you turn it, the oven starts by itself, the tray spins and the light comes on.

steps.action_native: After the ding, press the button to open the door
steps.action_en: After the ding, press the button to open the door
steps.narration_native: When time is up, the oven dings and stops by itself. Press the round button again to open the door and carefully take out your hot food.
steps.narration_en: When time is up, the oven dings and stops by itself. Press the round button again to open the door and carefully take out your hot food.

tips.native: If you take food out early, turn the timer back to 0 first. Always leave the timer at 0 when not in use.
tips.en: If you take food out early, turn the timer back to 0 first. Always leave the timer at 0 when not in use.

tips.native: To defrost, turn the power dial to the dot after Min with the defrost symbol, then set the time.
tips.en: To defrost, turn the power dial to the dot after Min with the defrost symbol, then set the time.

tips.native: The timer has no fine marks under 1 minute, so estimate short times; set a little less and add more if needed.
tips.en: The timer has no fine marks under 1 minute, so estimate short times; set a little less and add more if needed.

tips.native: Cleaning trick: put half a lemon in a bowl with 300 ml of water, run on Max for 10 minutes, then wipe the inside with a soft cloth.
tips.en: Cleaning trick: put half a lemon in a bowl with 300 ml of water, run on Max for 10 minutes, then wipe the inside with a soft cloth.

tips.native: Not sure if a dish is safe? Put it in empty with 250 ml cold water, run on Max for 1 minute. If the dish gets warm, don't use it.
tips.en: Not sure if a dish is safe? Put it in empty with 250 ml cold water, run on Max for 1 minute. If the dish gets warm, don't use it.

warnings.native: Never run the microwave empty; it can damage the oven.
warnings.en: Never run the microwave empty; it can damage the oven.

warnings.native: No metal: foil, metal-trimmed dishes or twist-ties can cause sparks.
warnings.en: No metal: foil, metal-trimmed dishes or twist-ties can cause sparks.

warnings.native: Don't heat eggs in their shells or sealed jars; they can explode.
warnings.en: Don't heat eggs in their shells or sealed jars; they can explode.

warnings.native: Heated water or drinks can suddenly boil over. Handle carefully, and stir and test baby food before feeding.
warnings.en: Heated water or drinks can suddenly boil over. Handle carefully, and stir and test baby food before feeding.

warnings.native: If something catches fire inside, keep the door closed! Turn the timer to 0 and unplug it.
warnings.en: If something catches fire inside, keep the door closed! Turn the timer to 0 and unplug it.

warnings.native: If the microwave is broken or won't work, never open the casing yourself; contact IKEA official support or your landlord.
warnings.en: If the microwave is broken or won't work, never open the casing yourself; contact IKEA official support or your landlord.

closing_native: That's all! Remember: open the door, put food in, close it, choose the power, then turn the timer. Enjoy your meal!
closing_en: That's all! Remember: open the door, put food in, close it, choose the power, then turn the timer. Enjoy your meal!
